flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-22, Region 4 Kootenay.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-22: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

Park: 49.76338, -115.40776, the rec site. Map links below.
Camp: 6 campsites (official).
Hunt: 1 hunting spots within 5 km of this camp (my pick).

F-camp-camp-0116.recDirections: Commencing at Fort Steele Historic Park, proceed north on Hwy 93/95 for 300 metres. Turn right onto the Wardner - Ft. Steele Road. Follow this road for 22km to the Power Plant Road. Turn left onto this road and follow it over the bridge on the Bull River Canyon. On the east side of the canyon, you will find yourself at the 22 km road marker on the Bull River FSR. Turn left and continue following the Bull River FSR to just past the 40 km road marker. Turn left up Galbraith FSR, stay right at the Tanglefoot road junction and proceed to the 63.5 km road marker. The recreation site is on your left.
